fightSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Finn Morozov. Carpenter. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Reading Glasses, Home key, Carpenter's square, Busker's harmonica, Daughter's Drawing. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.
A woman, maybe 30s: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
Something big drank here recently — the mud is churned to soup on the far bank. You drink from the near side, upstream of whatever it was.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.

Something moves out there — a dog-shaped silence at the treeline.
It followed you. The dog-shaped silence at the treeline is here.
The dog-shaped silence at the treeline stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Something moves out there — the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up.

No walls. No warning but the noise.

🚨 the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still, a dog-shaped silence at the treeline, a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer, something displaced a LOT of water, and it wasn't a log is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
